Selected details

Select a hero or trait to read its details here.

Select a hero, then choose a named board space. Drag heroes onto friendly spaces; dropping one on an occupied space swaps them. Drag a hero onto Shop to sell it. The board also supports tapping. Escape clears the selection.

Turn your device sideways

Landscape gives you a larger board. Rotate your phone, or use the compact controls if you cannot rotate.

Combat report

Hero damage counts health removed and damage absorbed by shields. Objective damage is separate. Amounts are rounded.
